fieldNotes.facility: Niagara Bottling Aurora, 1933 N Gun Club Rd. Confirmed by water-treatment silos at the building's east end and a Niagara monument/logo visible in Street View (2026-04). Modern build-to-suit bottling plant in the Aurora/I-70 industrial corridor.
fieldNotes.truckGate: Truck yard is fully enclosed by chain-link fence. The truck drive enters the fenced yard from the east/SE perimeter drive. A controlled gate is implied by the continuous perimeter fence; the exact barrier could not be resolved at max zoom (trees and shadow), so flagged.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No staffed multi-window guard booth visible at the yard entrance.
fieldNotes.remoteGs: Fenced/gated yard with no manned booth implies kiosk / app / remote check-in.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Long dock-door row along the full south face with many trailers backed in; estimated ~36 doors from z18 imagery, flagged approximate.
fieldNotes.dropArea: A separate row of parked trailers in the yard south of the dock apron, plus overflow trailers staged along the public road to the east.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Wide paved yard and unused width inside the fence; room to add an express bypass lane.
fieldNotes.entryLanes: Could not count lanes precisely at the yard gate; estimated 1 in / 1 out, flagged.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Dense Aurora industrial/warehouse park near I-70 - Urban.
fieldNotes.buildingCount: Single large Niagara building; neighboring warehouses are separate properties.

citations.claim: Company careers: "Join our plant in Aurora, CO!" active facility

verification.rationale: Long-established (2012) self-operated plant with current 2026 hiring; not a recent build.
